notes.title: Cubiverse will be free starting on December 24th!
notes.notes:
Dear Cubinauts,
As of December 24th, Cubiverse will be [b]free[/b]!

There will be no in-app purchases - it will be completely free. We made the game so that people could play it, and we believe that making it free is the best course of action moving forward.

We made this decision because this started out as a student project that we wanted to complete as a team. However, after some time, everyone has moved on to bigger and more exciting things. So, we decided to make it free.

What happens now?

Everyone will keep their copy of the game! If you have purchased Cubiverse, you have our eternal gratitude.
There will be [b]no new content[/b] added to the game.
However we will continue to read forums and fix any potential game blockers if possible. So, if you're stuck on a puzzle, don't be afraid to reach out for help!
We hope you all have some wonderful holidays!

Cheers,
The Cubiverse Team

notes.title: Score Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We have been made aware that some levels cannot be completed with 3 or even 2 stars!
This issue should now be resolved.
We used this opportunity to adjust some other levels whose turn counts were too easy.
You now have [b]more turns[/b] available for completing the levels marked in [b]bold[/b].

Turns needed for 2/3 stars changed for the following levels:
[list]
[*] Level 24: 16/12 -> 14/10
[*] Level 36: 25/17 -> 24/17
[*] [b]Level 38: 10/7 -> 12/8[/b]
[*] [b]Level 39: 14/10 -> 16/11[/b]
[*] [b]Level 40: 17/12 -> 20/14[/b]
[*] Level 41: 17/12 -> 14/10
[*] Level 42: 20/14 -> 19/13
[*] Level 52: 34/24 -> 23/16
[*] [b]Level 53: 21/15 -> 35/25[/b]
[*] [b]Level 54: 30/21 -> 31/22[/b]
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and for being part of our Community :)
[i]- Team Cubinauts[/i]

notes.title: Cubiverse Demo for Steam Next Fest & Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello cubinauts! 

We are very happy to share exciting news with you: 

To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we are [b]launching a demo for Cubiverse[/b] for the first time! 
And because we don't want the fun to end, Cubiverse is [b]releasing as a full game on the 7th of October at 6PM CET / 9AM PT[/b]! 

Please check out our demo and wishlist our game, that really helps us out a lot! And if you like the demo, please consider telling your friends about Cubiverse.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1680310/Cubiverse/?beta=0

Have fun puzzling!
[i]- Team Cubinauts[/i]
